I'm sorry your order is late. Tracking that hasn't moved for 4 business days qualifies for a courier investigation, and with no updates since Monday you've likely reached that point. The investigation takes up to 5 business days. If the package is found to be lost, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund.

Please send me your order number (it looks like LF-123456) so the investigation can be opened. Tracking can lag by up to 24 hours, so it's also worth checking the tracking link once more.
